mapping.summary: Runs Microsoft Subscription Billing actions from integrations, schedules or AI assistants.
claims: Applies packages and attaches subscription lines to customer or vendor contracts
Bills a single contract or turns a billing proposal into posted documents
A billing run can be undone before posting
Previews a contract or run with real figures without saving
Imports usage files and links them to subscriptions for usage billing
Closes ended lines, merges contract lines and updates exchange rates on foreign-currency contracts
Releases deferrals, extends subscriptions and creates renewal quotes
Converts staged import rows into subscriptions and contracts
Requires Microsoft's Subscription Billing app, BC 28.3+ and Bifrost Foundation
